opportunities.opportunity_id: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the priority questions, have a clear path to impact, a clear conceptual framework, appropriate and rigorous methodology, experienced team, and offer good value for money. Individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant, projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any particular organisation, projects led by schools or further education colleges, projects led by undergraduates or master’s students, PhD fees or projects where the main purpose is to support a PhD, the establishment of academic posts, ongoing costs or the costs of ‘rolling out’ existing work or services, ‘dissemination-only’ projects, local charities, replacement for statutory funding, or local social services or social welfare provision, requests for financial help or educational fees from or on behalf of individuals, and projects led by organisations or institutions that are not based in the UK are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the priority questions outlined in the Nuffield Foundation's Strategic Review.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly from individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities, are encouraged. Partnership applications which bring together researchers and racially minoritised communities to explore challenges and develop solutions are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter-generational changes, continuities, and challenges in racially diverse UK.
